import random, sys, subprocess, struct
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import brute, pipeline
random.seed(999)
def c_table(entries, ms, helper='/workspace/tmp/ftabtest/ftab'):
    payload = bytearray(struct.pack('<III', 0x31424654, ms, len(entries)))
    for a,l,h in entries:
        payload += a.to_bytes(16,'big'); payload.append(l)
    p = subprocess.run([helper], input=bytes(payload), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    vals = struct.unpack('<%dQ' % (129*129), p.stdout)
    return [list(vals[i*129:(i+1)*129]) for i in range(129)]
bad=0
for trial in range(120):
    n = random.choice([0,1,2,4,7,12,20])
    seen=set(); entries=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        length = random.choice([0,1,4,8,16,17,32,33,64,96,127,128])
        addr = pipeline.trunc(random.getrandbits(128), length)
        if (addr,length) in seen: continue
        seen.add((addr,length)); entries.append((addr,length,random.randrange(65536)))
    ms = random.choice([1,2,3,5,16,32])
    tab = brute.brute_table(entries, ms)
    c = c_table(entries, ms)
    for (b,e),v in tab.items():
        if c[b][e] != v:
            bad+=1; print('MISMATCH', trial); break
